proposals.evidence: Turner lists Nepali hā̃siyo and Hindi hãsiyā/hasiyā sickle under aṁsiya, shaped like a shoulder-blade. The Tharu hasiyā/hasīyā cutting-tool responses match this family; the source’s broader knife gloss is preserved.
